params.name: results
params.description: Number of user records to generate. Maximum 5000 per request.

params.name: gender
params.description: Restrict to a single gender. Omit or use any other value to return both.

params.name: nat
params.description:
Comma-separated list of two-letter nationality codes. Supported (v1.4):
AU, BR, CA, CH, DE, DK, ES, FI, FR, GB, IE, IN, IR, MX, NL, NO, NZ,
RS, TR, UA, US. Omit for a mix of all nationalities.

params.name: inc
params.description:
Comma-separated list of top-level fields to include. Allowed values:
gender, name, location, email, login, registered, dob, phone, cell,
id, picture, nat. Mutually exclusive with `exc`.

params.name: exc
params.description:
Comma-separated list of top-level fields to exclude. Allowed values
same as `inc`. Mutually exclusive with `inc`.

params.name: seed
params.description:
Deterministic seed. The same seed (with the same page, results, and
version) always returns the same users.

params.name: page
params.description:
Page number (1-based) for paginated seeded results. Use with `seed`
and a fixed `results` value to walk a stable dataset.

params.name: format
params.description: Response serialization format. Defaults to JSON.

params.name: password
params.description:
Password composition rules: `CHARSETS,MIN-MAX` or `CHARSETS,MAX`.
Charsets: special, upper, lower, number (comma-separated, in any order).
Default: ~10k top-used passwords; otherwise 8-64 characters.

params.name: dl
params.description:
If present, returns the response as a file download with the
appropriate extension for the requested `format`.

params.name: noinfo
params.description:
If present, omits the `info` envelope (seed, results, page, version)
from the response.

params.name: callback
params.description: JSONP callback function name. Only honored for JSON formats.

items.docs:
Generate one or more random user records. Supports controlling result count,
gender, nationality mix, included/excluded fields, password composition,
format (JSON/CSV/YAML/XML/PrettyJSON), seeded reproducibility, and pagination.
